The Second Star

Composed by G.Tate.It goes well in a set with the Beeswing Hornpipe

↳ Posted by dafydd on February 28th, 2003.

The Second Star

Dezi Donnelly plays this followed by The Sunshine Hornpipe - it works really well together.

↳ Posted by Faerie Feet on May 19th, 2006.

Don’t know who G. Tate is/was, but this tune is in Ryan’s Mammoth Collection with no author attributed, “Star of the East-Hornpipe (can be used as a Clog),” in the key of Bb. I learned it from an old 78 by Canadian fiddler Joseph Laroque: http://tiny.cc/qY75z Buddy McMaster plays it on one of his records as well. Laroque also recorded Ostinelli’s, another flashy hornpipe.

The Second Star, X:4

Matt Molloy plays The Second Star beautifully in D on his new CD, Back to the Island. The high notes are accessible and worth going for. This is not an exact, accurate transcription of the way he plays the tune but it’s close enough to be a way into the tune as he plays it.
